node.mjs = dist/node.mjs from the npm package realtime-bpm-analyzer 5.6.1 (https://github.com/dlepaux/realtime-bpm-analyzer, Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.md). Unmodified.
run.mjs is ours: reads mono float32 PCM from stdin, prints the tempo candidates as JSON. Used by rtbpm.py as a second opinion on BPM.
